name: How long does a kitchen expansion project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen expansion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen expansion project can vary depending on its complexity and the extent of the structural work required. A minor expansion might take 8-12 weeks, while a more extensive project involving significant structural changes, foundation work, and utility rerouting could take 4-6 months or even longer. This timeframe includes design, permitting, demolition, construction, and finishing touches. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront.
